selection_rationale: M10 is the active survivor after the six-hour rounds. Its exact integer-time Fejer bridge removes the block-merger and continuous-reconstruction losses, including the width-one prime, and reduces closure to one weighted joint CRT tail theorem. M05 remains mathematically surviving because it proves the symmetric density-scale theorem and a 6^q one-block orthant successor, but its A-line allocation is stopped: no multiscale merger was obtained and the standard continuous full-system majorant is impossible when k+1 is prime. M08 remains a dormant distinct covering-entropy survivor and was not advanced in these rounds. None of the three is promoted; the public exponent is unchanged.
